unsupported: Country Hillside Designs operates from Ryder, North Dakota, where owner Patti Shelkey founded the business in 2010.
The company adopted its current name in 2021, evolving from Shelkey's vision of a cottage-style shop where customers could explore rooms filled with designed apparel.
Shelkey, who grew up around horses, cattle, and the outdoors, built the business around storytelling through stitching and printing.
Shelkey frames the work as narrative: each embroidered logo or printed design marks a family story, a milestone, or a brand identity.
